title: Unified Renderer-Neutral Store Abstraction
description: Introduce abstract Store<TSnapshot> in @framework/core, controller-owned store registry, Component extends Store, renderer useStore hooks, sketchpad SemioKitStore + local store, puzzle play controllers provide domain stores. Full unification, no backwards compat.
summary: Introduced renderer-neutral abstract Store<TSnapshot> in @framework/core with ObservableCell and AppPointerFocusStore as subclasses. Controller now owns stores via provideStore/getStore/stores and disposes them on teardown. Component extends Store (getSnapshot/buildSnapshot); PlatformComponentEntry replaced by SurfaceComponent. Platform renderer exports useStore and useControllerStore. Sketchpad: SemioKitStore + InMemorySemioKitStore on SketchpadShellController (shell ObservableCell + per-kit stores); removed KitHostStore registry bridge; VS Code webview registers kits on controller. Puzzle 5d: TopologyStoreBridge on TopologyPlayShellController; TopologyStore.getModel renamed readTopology. Tests: @framework/core 16/16, @framework/platform/core 10/10, platform renderer 11/11, playground renderer 13/13, puzzle 5d play vitest 6/6, puzzle 3d play vitest 13/13.
